shadows.label: 阴影 1 - Shadow 1
shadows.description: Shadow Black (`rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12)`): Big confident shadows — Bumble does not whisper.

shadows.label: 阴影 2 - Shadow 2
shadows.description: Shadow on hero CTAs: `rgba(255, 198, 41, 0.4) 0 8px 24px` — yellow glow shadow for the "Make the first move" hero

shadows.label: 阴影 3 - Shadow 3
shadows.description: Heart Yes is the hero: 64pt circle, `#FFC629` fill, black heart glyph at 28pt, `rgba(255, 198, 41, 0.5) 0 6px 16px` glow shadow

shadows.label: 阴影 4 - Shadow 4
shadows.description: Thumb: 24pt circle, white fill with `rgba(0,0,0,0.15) 0 2px 6px` shadow, 2pt `#FFC629` inner stroke

shadows.label: 阴影 5 - Shadow 5
shadows.description: "Build the Bumble swipe action row: 5 circular buttons in a horizontal row below the card. From left: Rewind (48pt, `#F5F5F5` fill, gray glyph), X Pass (56pt, white fill with 1.5pt `#1F1F1F` stroke, black X), Heart Yes (64pt, `#FFC629` Bumble Yellow fill, 28pt black heart glyph, with a `rgba(255,198,41,0.5) 0 6px 16px` yellow glow shadow), Star SuperSwipe (56pt, `#FFC629` fill, black star), Bee Compliment (56pt, white fill with 1.5pt `#FFC629` stroke, yellow-and-black bee glyph). Press animation: scale 0.9 on press. Heart triggers `medium-emphasis confirmation state`; SuperSwipe `success confirmation state`; Bee `soft-emphasis confirmation state`."

borders.label: 边框 3 - Border 3
borders.description: Warm Bumble Black (`#1F1F1F`) — slightly warm near-black for type and dark surfaces, never pure

borders.label: 边框 4 - Border 4
borders.description: Bumble's iOS app is unapologetically loud. Where Hinge whispers on cream paper and Tinder neon-flames at you, Bumble paints the screen Bumble Yellow (`#FFC629`) — a saturated, sun-bright honey-yellow — and lets it bake. The yellow is everywhere: the splash, the loading dots, the active tab, the primary CTA, the match badge, the hexagon honeycomb that frames every photo and notification. The brand is a single color used with stadium-rock confidence, paired with a near-black warm canvas to keep contrast brutal. If Hinge is a journal, Bumble is a billboard.

borders.label: 边框 5 - Border 5
borders.description: Honey Deep (`#F5B616`) for pressed states and the "send a Compliment" premium moments

borders.label: 边框 6 - Border 6
borders.description: Match Pink (`#E94B7B`): Reserved for the "It's a Match!" celebration heart; not used in chrome — the match heart is the only place this pink appears.

do: 建议：Use Bumble Yellow ({#FFC629}) as the dominant action color — it's the brand。
建议：Pair yellow with pure black ({#000000}) for text on yellow surfaces — WCAG AA requires it。
建议：Use Brando weights 500/700/900 — the brand is heavy and confident。
建议：Render the heart action button with a yellow glow shadow — {rgba(255, 198, 41, 0.5) 0 6px 16px}。
建议：Use the hexagon shape for the brand mark, match notification photo crops, and mode toggle buttons。
dont: 避免：use white text on Bumble Yellow — contrast fails WCAG; always pure black。
避免：use Bumble Yellow for body text — yellow is a verb, never type。
避免：soften the photo aspect to 4:5 portrait (that's Hinge) — Bumble uses 3:4。
避免：replace the hexagon with a circle on match notifications — the hex is the brand spatial signature。
避免：use Brando Light or Thin — the brand doesn't have light weights。
